notes: kb/Work PB5575. §2002:8.8.1.3.1.3 situation 2: a standard intermediate data item that is the argument of a function with no equivalent arithmetic expression is rounded to 31 digits. IntrinsicRenderer.StandardArgument rounds such an argument (CobolDec.ToSidiRounded) unless IntrinsicCarrierRules.RoundsStandardArgument names a function whose argument keeps all 32 digits (an equivalent expression, SQRT, the comparison functions, INTEGER at 2002). DATE-OF-INTEGER (145732 + 1 / K * K) is 20000102, DAY-OF-INTEGER 2000002, INTEGER-OF-DATE (20000100 + 1 / K * K) 145732; INTEGER-PART and INTEGER (2002) keep .99999999999999999999999999999999 and give 0.
